lots.title: QTY OF TASMANIAN RELATED BOOKS
lots.findings: Titles read: (1) 'Hotel and Boarding House Directory Tasmania 1926-1927', issued by the Tasmanian Government Tourist Department, Treasury Buildings Hobart; mainland branches Melbourne, Sydney; agencies Adelaide, Brisbane, Perth; printed at 'The Examiner' and 'Weekly Courier' offices, Launceston and Hobart; ownership signature in pencil on cover (looks like 'R... Williams'); (2) 'A Donation to the Colony' by Eva Meidl (40 South Publishing); (3) a black cloth-bound volume with no visible spine title (unreadable/unlabelled); (4) Tasmanian Historical Studies Volume 8 No. 2 (2003); (5) The Dr. Clifford Craig Collection, Vol. II, auction catalogue, Monday Oct. 13, 1975 and two days following (useful reference for Tasmanian colonial furniture and antiques); (6) 'Mures Fish Tales and Tasmanian Seafood'; (7) 'Brothers' Home: The Story of Derby, Tasmania' by John Beswick; (8) 'Open to Talent' by Richard Davis (University of Tasmania history); (9) 'Subantarctic Wilderness' by Terauds and Stewart; (10) 'Sesquicentenary of the Separation of Van Diemen's Land from New South Wales 1825-1975' (oblong booklet with royal arms). At least one further thin item under the directory is unread. Value is mainly in the 1926-27 tourist directory (scarce interwar Tasmanian tourism ephemera) and the 1975 Clifford Craig catalogue.

lots.identification: Stack of about 11 Tasmanian books and booklets.
